systems.owner: Directorate General of Decentralization and Local Development, Ministry of the Interior and Territorial Administration; mayors, deputies and municipal councillors register
systems.tiers: main centres at the headquarters of municipalities, boroughs and diplomatic missions; secondary centres in villages, urban areas and health facilities; records sent to the Central Registry

note: UNICEF's civil registration profile, compiled December 2016 to November 2017: births, marriages and deaths are recorded by hand on non-standard paper forms at centres in municipal headquarters and sent to the Central Registry; that is the paper state of an application, and the profile states nothing on whether a municipal office has a connection.
